thread:
Maria (release-mgr): Quick heads-up — planning to unpin runtime v2.14 for the orca2q model in the EU canary window tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Reason: perf improvements and quant fixes. Will roll only to canary initially.
Ben (eng-runtime): thanks. do we have SDK compatibility verified? sdk 2.7 still has the shim, right?
David (sdk): SDK 2.7 has the runtime shim, but there were one or two telemetry fields renamed. Should be backward compatible for inference, but streaming paths differ slightly. recommend a smoke pass.
Maria (release-mgr): OK — schedule smoke and a short integration test against chat + longseq. Ben, can you add a runtime guard to auto-fallback to v2.13 if lat > 350ms?
Ben (eng-runtime): can do. I'll add a routing policy: if p50>300ms or p99>900ms across canary nodes for 5m, trigger fallback. Also enabling KV-cache warmup for orca2q.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy job #deploy-4821 created by Maria; canary window 2024-12-14T09:00Z; job: runtime-unpin-orca2q-v2.14 -> canary(5%) -> 30m -> evaluate.
SRE-Oncall: please include memory and GPU utilization checks in the smoke so we catch potential OOM regressions. we saw a spike with llama3q earlier.
Ben (eng-runtime): adding mem/gpu thresholds to the smoke script. also adding quick config to disable quantized kernels if OOM.
David (sdk): i'll run the SDK smoke against the canary endpoint 30m before roll. will post results.
Maria (release-mgr): if canary fails, we'll hold and open rollback plan. Ben/David, what's the rollback sequence? short bullets pls.
Ben (eng-runtime): rollback plan: 1) abort canary job, 2) update deploy-bot pinlist to re-pin runtime v2.13 for orca2q, 3) trigger gradual traffic shift back to v2.13, 4) monitor for 15m, 5) postmortem if >1% errors.
David (sdk): SDK note: if we re-pin, we should increment shim compatibility flag in the header so clients can opt-in. small server-side header: `x-rw-runtime-shim: v2.13`. will prepare patch.
Alice (docs): i'll draft a one-paragraph release note and an Ops playbook snippet for the rollback steps. will link in the release ticket.
deploy-bot: canary job #deploy-4821 started (canary group 1/3). logs: `starting runtime v2.14 on node eu-canary-05`
Ben (eng-runtime): seeing initial p50 ~ 220ms, p99 ~ 820ms. mem stable. continuing to monitor.
deploy-bot: canary job #deploy-4821 health-check: node eu-canary-06 failed healthcheck (OOM). auto-scaling triggered.
SRE-Oncall: noticed eu-canary-06 OOM. rolling back that node, isolating logs. Ben — can you revert quant kernel toggle for that node?
Ben (eng-runtime): toggled kernel back on eu-canary-06 and drained. not sure it's safe to proceed with more canary traffic until we root cause.
Maria (release-mgr): agreed — HOLD the rollout. aborting remaining canary groups. deploy-bot: abort canary and mark for rollback.
deploy-bot: job #deploy-4821 aborted by Maria. pinlist updated: runtime pinned to v2.13 for model orca2q in EU.
David (sdk): pushing header patch to staging and will coordinate a hotfix branch for the shim mapping.
Alice (docs): updating release notes: mark unpin postponed, include brief incident note for OOM during canary.
Maria (release-mgr): good call everyone. follow-ups: Ben to lead root cause (OOM), David to finish shim patch, Alice to update docs. we'll re-queue unpin after at least one successful canary node and a cross-team signoff. :thumbsup:
Ben (eng-runtime): started a short RCA ticket (#RCA-1287) and attached core logs from eu-canary-06.
SRE-Oncall: i'll attach system-level metrics and GPU traces.
Maria (release-mgr): last check — I've set a new tentative window next week, but will only re-schedule after we have RCA + mitigation. closing thread for now.
